# mimecast_dmarc_spf_definition (Resource)

Manage the SPF definition for a delegated DMARC Analyzer domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_dmarc_spf_definition" "example" {
  domain_id     = mimecast_dmarc_delegated_domain.example.id
  version       = "v=spf1"
  all_qualifier = "~all"

  terms = [
    {
      type   = "include"
      target = "_spf.provider.example"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `all_qualifier` (String) SPF all mechanism qualifier.
- `domain_id` (String) Delegated managed-domain ID.
- `version` (String) SPF version, such as v=spf1.

### Optional

- `terms` (Attributes List) Ordered SPF terms. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--terms))

### Read-Only

- `compressed_value` (String) Compressed SPF record.
- `id` (String) SPF definition ID, equal to the delegated domain ID.
- `normalized_value` (String) Normalized uncompressed SPF record.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the SPF record is published.
- `record_name` (String) Published SPF record name.
- `record_ttl` (Number) Published SPF record TTL.
- `record_type` (String) Published SPF record type.
- `record_value` (String) Published SPF record value.

<a id="nestedatt--terms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `terms`

Required:

- `target` (String) SPF term target.
- `type` (String) SPF term type.

Optional:

- `cidr_ipv4` (Number) IPv4 CIDR prefix length.
- `cidr_ipv6` (Number) IPv6 CIDR prefix length.
- `label` (String) SPF term label.
- `source_id` (String) Associated source ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_dmarc_spf_definition.example delegated-domain-id
```
